#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""The acknowledgements (#376, spec §11 PUB-10): every third-party notice the bundle owes,
written each build into `Contents/Resources/Acknowledgements.txt` by project.yml's "Write
Acknowledgements" step; byte-identical for identical inputs, written atomically.

    python3 tools/licenses/acknowledgements.py --out PATH [--strict-bun] [--sparkle-license PATH]
    python3 tools/licenses/acknowledgements.py --print-bun-version
    python3 tools/licenses/acknowledgements.py --selftest | --mutant dev-edges|nested-unchecked|bun-unchecked

Crates over every non-dev edge of `cargo metadata` (not FIRST_PARTY), npm from `agent/bun.lock`
(no dev dependency or optional peer), each with its root licence files, else `spdx/<id>.txt`
under its authors, NESTED deciding every nested licence file; then Bun (BUN_LICENSE_VERSION,
`--strict-bun` refusing another), Sparkle, the encoders, the model and the fonts. D42/D43
(dist_check.py) read the file with their own readers. A `--mutant` fails exactly its rows:
`dev-edges` G1, `nested-unchecked` L3, `bun-unchecked` B1. Stdlib only, Python 3.9.
"""

import argparse, json, os, re, shutil, struct, subprocess, sys, tempfile  # noqa: E401
from pathlib import Path
from typing import NamedTuple, Optional

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
HERE = ROOT / "tools" / "licenses"
sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT / "tools" / "codecs"))
import build_codecs  # noqa: E402  (PINS: the encoders, in order)

FIRST_PARTY = ("framejob-core", "graphic", "framejob-mcp")
CARGO_ROOTS = ("core", "mcp-proxy")
TARGET = "aarch64-apple-darwin"
BUN_LICENSE_VERSION = "1.3.6"
LICENCE_PREFIXES = ("LICENSE", "LICENCE", "COPYING", "NOTICE", "UNLICENSE")
NESTED = {("rquickjs-sys", "quickjs/LICENSE"): True, ("rquickjs-sys", "vendor/wasi-libc/NOTICE.md"):
          False, ("fontdb", "tests/fonts/LICENSE.txt"): False,
          ("@anthropic-ai/sdk", "src/internal/qs/LICENSE.md"): True}
PATCHED = {"tiny-skia": "spec §11 PR-13"}
LIBRARY_LICENCES = {"svt-av1": "BSD-3-Clause-Clear (parts BSD-2-Clause), with the Alliance for "
                               "Open Media Patent License 1.0",
                    "libvpx": "BSD-3-Clause, with the WebM Project's patent grant"}
SPARKLE_LICENSE = Path("SourcePackages/artifacts/sparkle/Sparkle/LICENSE")
CRATES_IO = "registry+https://github.com/rust-lang/crates.io-index"
EXPECTED = {"dev-edges": {"G1"}, "nested-unchecked": {"L3"}, "bun-unchecked": {"B1"}}
MUTANT = None
PREAMBLE = ("Frame Job is licensed under the Apache License, Version 2.0. It includes the "
            "third-party software below, each under the licence its entry names, followed by "
            "that licence's full text (or, where the same text appeared above, a pointer to it).")


class Entry(NamedTuple):
    kind: str
    name: str
    version: str
    licence: str
    source: str
    texts: tuple  # ((label, text), ...)


class Failed(RuntimeError):
    pass


def read(path):
    return Path(path).read_text(encoding="utf-8", errors="replace")


def cargo_packages(metadata: dict) -> list:
    """Package dicts reachable from resolve.root over non-dev edges, FIRST_PARTY removed."""
    packages = {p["id"]: p for p in metadata["packages"]}
    nodes = {n["id"]: n for n in metadata["resolve"]["nodes"]}
    seen, stack = set(), [metadata["resolve"]["root"]]
    while stack:
        current = stack.pop()
        if current not in seen:
            seen.add(current)
            stack += [d["pkg"] for d in nodes[current].get("deps", []) if MUTANT == "dev-edges"
                      or any(k.get("kind") != "dev" for k in d.get("dep_kinds", []))]
    return [packages[i] for i in sorted(seen) if packages[i]["name"] not in FIRST_PARTY]


def npm_packages(lock_text: str) -> list:
    """[(name, version)] from workspaces[""].dependencies through each package's
    "dependencies"; not devDependencies, not optionalPeers."""
    lock = json.loads(re.sub(r",(\s*[}\]])", r"\1", lock_text))
    entries, found = lock.get("packages", {}), {}
    stack = [("", name) for name in sorted(lock["workspaces"][""].get("dependencies", {}))]
    while stack:
        parent, name = stack.pop()
        key = f"{parent}/{name}" if parent and f"{parent}/{name}" in entries else name
        if key not in entries:
            raise Failed(f"acknowledgements: {name} is not in agent/bun.lock's packages")
        if key in found:
            continue
        entry = entries[key]
        found[key] = (name, entry[0].rsplit("@", 1)[1])
        meta = entry[2] if len(entry) > 2 and isinstance(entry[2], dict) else {}
        stack += [(key, dep) for dep in sorted(meta.get("dependencies", {}))]
    return sorted(set(found.values()))


def licence_texts(directory: Path, owner: str, licence: str, authors: list) -> tuple:
    """((label, text), ...): the root licence files, else the canonical SPDX texts under the
    authors; then each nested licence file NESTED includes."""
    directory = Path(directory)
    texts = [(p.name, read(p)) for p in sorted(directory.iterdir())
             if p.is_file() and p.name.upper().startswith(LICENCE_PREFIXES)]
    if not texts:
        if not licence:
            raise Failed(f"acknowledgements: {owner} ships no licence file and declares none")
        holders = ", ".join(authors) if authors else f"the {owner} authors"
        ids = [t for t in re.findall(r"[A-Za-z0-9.+-]+", licence) if t not in ("AND", "OR", "WITH")]
        if " AND " not in licence and "(" not in licence:  # alternatives: the first with a text
            ids = [i for i in ids if (HERE / "spdx" / f"{i}.txt").is_file()][:1] or ids
        for spdx in ids:
            canonical = HERE / "spdx" / f"{spdx}.txt"
            if not canonical.is_file():
                raise Failed(f"acknowledgements: {owner} ships no licence file and there is no "
                             f"canonical text for {spdx} (tools/licenses/spdx/{spdx}.txt)")
            texts.append((f"{spdx} (the SPDX text; {owner} ships no licence file)",
                          f"Copyright (c) {holders}\n\n{read(canonical)}"))
    for folder, dirs, files in os.walk(directory):
        here = Path(folder)
        dirs[:] = sorted(d for d in dirs if d not in ("target", "node_modules")
                         and not (here / d / "Cargo.toml").exists()
                         and not (here / d / "package.json").exists())
        for name in sorted(files) if here != directory else ():
            relative = (here / name).relative_to(directory).as_posix()
            listed = NESTED.get((owner, relative))
            licence_file = name.upper().startswith(LICENCE_PREFIXES)
            if licence_file and listed is None and MUTANT != "nested-unchecked":
                raise Failed(f"acknowledgements: {owner}'s nested licence file {relative} is "
                             "not in NESTED (tools/licenses/acknowledgements.py); list it")
            if licence_file and listed:
                texts.append((relative, read(here / name)))
    return tuple(texts)


def font_revision(path: Path) -> str:
    """The `head` table's fontRevision (16.16 fixed), to three decimals."""
    data = Path(path).read_bytes()
    count = struct.unpack(">H", data[4:6])[0] if len(data) >= 12 else 0
    for index in range(count):
        tag, _, offset, _ = struct.unpack(">4sIII", data[12 + 16 * index:28 + 16 * index])
        if tag == b"head":
            return f"{struct.unpack('>i', data[offset + 4:offset + 8])[0] / 65536:.3f}"
    raise Failed(f"acknowledgements: {path} has no sfnt head table")


def bun_check(found, strict):
    """None when `found` is BUN_LICENSE_VERSION; else Failed under `strict`, or the note."""
    if found == BUN_LICENSE_VERSION:
        return None
    message = (f"bun --version is {found or '(no bun found)'}, but the vendored licence is Bun "
               f"{BUN_LICENSE_VERSION}'s; re-vendor it (tools/licenses/PROVENANCE.md)")
    if strict and MUTANT != "bun-unchecked":
        raise Failed(f"acknowledgements: {message}")
    return message


def _crates(root):
    found = {}
    for folder in CARGO_ROOTS:
        argv = ["cargo", "metadata", "--format-version", "1", "--locked", "--offline",
                "--filter-platform", TARGET]
        done = subprocess.run(argv, cwd=str(root / folder), capture_output=True, text=True)
        if done.returncode != 0:
            raise Failed(f"acknowledgements: {' '.join(argv)} in {folder}/ exited "
                         f"{done.returncode}: {done.stderr.strip()[-300:]}")
        found.update((p["id"], p) for p in cargo_packages(json.loads(done.stdout)))
    entries = []
    for p in sorted(found.values(), key=lambda p: (p["name"], p["version"])):
        directory = Path(p["manifest_path"]).parent
        source = "crates.io" if p.get("source") == CRATES_IO else p.get("source")
        if source is None:
            patched = f" (patched, {PATCHED[p['name']]})" if p["name"] in PATCHED else ""
            source = f"vendored at {os.path.relpath(directory, root)}{patched}"
        licence = p.get("license") or ""
        texts = licence_texts(directory, p["name"], licence, p.get("authors") or [])
        entries.append(Entry("crate", p["name"], p["version"], licence or "(none declared)",
                             source, texts))
    return entries


def _npm(root):
    entries = []
    for name, version in npm_packages(read(root / "agent" / "bun.lock")):
        directory = root / "agent" / "node_modules" / name
        try:
            manifest = json.loads(read(directory / "package.json"))
        except (OSError, ValueError) as error:
            raise Failed(f"acknowledgements: agent/node_modules/{name}/package.json: {error}")
        if manifest.get("version") != version:
            raise Failed(f"acknowledgements: agent/bun.lock pins {name} {version}, but "
                         f"node_modules holds {manifest.get('version')} (run bun install)")
        licence, author = manifest.get("license") or "", manifest.get("author")
        licence = licence.get("type", "") if isinstance(licence, dict) else licence
        author = author.get("name") if isinstance(author, dict) else author
        texts = licence_texts(directory, name, licence, [author] if author else [])
        entries.append(Entry("npm", name, version, licence or "(none declared)", "npm", texts))
    return sorted(entries, key=lambda e: e.name)


def _sparkle(root, build_dir, sparkle_license):
    if sparkle_license is None:
        starts = [Path(build_dir)] if build_dir else []
        tried = [folder / SPARKLE_LICENSE for start in starts for folder in [start, *start.parents]]
        tried.append(root / "build" / SPARKLE_LICENSE)
        sparkle_license = next((path for path in tried if path.is_file()), None)
        if sparkle_license is None:
            raise Failed("acknowledgements: Sparkle's LICENSE is in none of "
                         + ", ".join(map(str, tried)))
    state_path = Path(sparkle_license).parents[3] / "workspace-state.json"
    try:
        version = [d["state"]["checkoutState"]["version"]
                   for d in json.loads(read(state_path))["object"]["dependencies"]
                   if d["packageRef"]["identity"] == "sparkle"][0]
    except (OSError, ValueError, KeyError, IndexError, TypeError) as error:
        raise Failed(f"acknowledgements: no resolved sparkle version in {state_path}: {error!r}")
    return Entry("framework", "sparkle", version, "MIT (with the notices its LICENSE lists)",
                 "https://github.com/sparkle-project/Sparkle", (("LICENSE", read(sparkle_license)),))


def collect(root: Path, build_dir: Optional[str], strict_bun: bool,
            sparkle_license: Optional[Path]) -> list:
    root = Path(root)
    entries = _crates(root) + _npm(root)
    bun = shutil.which("bun")
    done = bun and subprocess.run([bun, "--version"], capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=60)
    note = bun_check(done.stdout.strip() if done and done.returncode == 0 else None, strict_bun)
    if note:
        print(f"warning: {note}", file=sys.stderr, flush=True)
    entries.append(Entry(
        "runtime", "bun", BUN_LICENSE_VERSION,
        "MIT; it embeds JavaScriptCore and WebKit (LGPL-2) and the libraries its notice lists",
        f"https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/tree/bun-v{BUN_LICENSE_VERSION}",
        ((("note", note),) if note else ()) + (("LICENSE.md", read(HERE / "bun/LICENSE.txt")),)))
    entries.append(_sparkle(root, build_dir, sparkle_license))
    for pin in build_codecs.PINS:
        paths = [root / "build/codecs/licenses" / pin.name / name for _, name in pin.licenses]
        entries.append(Entry("library", pin.name, pin.version, LIBRARY_LICENCES[pin.name],
                             pin.url, tuple((path.name, read(path)) for path in paths)))
    models = root / "app/Resources/Models"
    tag = re.search(r"tag `v([^`]+)`", read(models / "PROVENANCE.md"))
    if tag is None:
        raise Failed("acknowledgements: no tag `vX` in app/Resources/Models/PROVENANCE.md")
    entries.append(Entry("model", "silero-vad", tag.group(1), "MIT",
                         "https://github.com/snakers4/silero-vad",
                         (("LICENSE", read(models / "LICENSE")),)))
    fonts = root / "app/Resources/Fonts"
    for font in sorted(fonts.glob("*.ttf"), key=lambda p: p.stem):
        ofl = fonts / f"OFL-{font.stem.split('-')[0]}.txt"
        if not ofl.is_file():
            raise Failed(f"acknowledgements: {font.name} has no {ofl.name} beside it")
        entries.append(Entry("font", font.stem, font_revision(font), "OFL-1.1",
                             "vendored at app/Resources/Fonts", ((ofl.name, read(ofl)),)))
    return entries


def render(entries: list) -> str:
    out, first = ["Frame Job — third-party software notices", "Generated at build time by "
                  "tools/licenses/acknowledgements.py; do not edit.", PREAMBLE, ""], {}
    for e in entries:
        out += [f"== {e.kind} {e.name} {e.version} ==", f"Licence: {e.licence}",
                f"Source: {e.source}"]
        for label, text in e.texts:
            out.append(f"--- {label} ---")
            if text in first:
                out.append(f"(identical to {first[text]}, above)")
            else:
                first[text] = f"{e.kind} {e.name} {e.version}'s {label}"
                out.append(text.rstrip("\n"))
        out.append("")
    return "\n".join(out)


def selftest(mutant=None):
    """No cargo, no network, scratch only."""
    global MUTANT
    MUTANT, results = mutant, []

    def row(name, ok, detail):
        results.append((name, bool(ok)))
        print(f"  {'ok  ' if ok else 'FAIL'} {name} {detail}", flush=True)

    def failure(call):
        try:
            call()
        except Failed as error:
            return str(error)

    def put(path, text):
        path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        path.write_text(text)

    scratch = Path(tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix="acknowledgements-selftest-"))
    try:
        entries = [Entry("crate", "a", "1.0", "MIT", "crates.io", (("LICENSE", "text a\n"),)),
                   Entry("crate", "b", "2.0", "MIT", "crates.io", (("LICENSE", "text a\n"),)),
                   Entry("font", "F-Bold", "1.500", "OFL-1.1", "x", (("OFL-F.txt", "ofl\n"),))]
        one, two = render(entries), render(list(entries))
        row("D0", one.encode() == two.encode(),
            f"CONTROL: two renders are byte-identical ({len(one)} characters)")
        row("T1", "(identical to crate a 1.0's LICENSE, above)" in one
            and one.count("\ntext a\n") == 1, "a repeated text becomes the 'identical to' line")
        def node(i, *deps):
            return {"id": i, "deps": [{"pkg": d, "dep_kinds": [{"kind": k}]} for d, k in deps]}
        ids = ("framejob-core", "graphic", "lib", "devonly", "buildonly", "devdeep")
        metadata = {"packages": [{"id": i, "name": i, "version": "1"} for i in ids],
                    "resolve": {"root": "framejob-core", "nodes": [
                        node("framejob-core", ("graphic", None), ("devonly", "dev"),
                             ("buildonly", "build")),
                        node("graphic", ("lib", None)), node("lib"),
                        node("devonly", ("devdeep", None)), node("buildonly"), node("devdeep")]}}
        names = {p["name"] for p in cargo_packages(metadata)}
        row("G1", not names & {"devonly", "devdeep", *FIRST_PARTY} and "lib" in names,
            f"dev edges and first-party are excluded: {sorted(names)}")
        row("G2", "buildonly" in names, f"build edges are included: {sorted(names)}")
        lock = """{ "workspaces": { "": { "dependencies": { "a": "^1", }, "devDependencies": {
    "dev": "^1", }, }, }, "packages": { "a": ["a@1.2.0", "", { "dependencies": { "b": "^2", },
    "peerDependencies": { "p": "^1" }, "optionalPeers": ["p"], }, "sha512-x"], "b": ["b@2.0.1",
    "", {}, "y"], "dev": ["dev@1.0.0", "", {}, "z"], "p": ["p@1.0.0", "", {}, "w"], } }"""
        got = npm_packages(lock)
        row("N1", got == [("a", "1.2.0"), ("b", "2.0.1")],
            f"a trailing-comma lock skips dev deps and optional peers: {got}")
        (scratch / "bare").mkdir()
        texts = licence_texts(scratch / "bare", "bare", "MIT", ["Ann <ann@example.com>"])
        row("L1", len(texts) == 1 and texts[0][1].startswith("Copyright (c) Ann <ann@example")
            and "Permission is hereby granted" in texts[0][1],
            f"no licence file gives the SPDX text under the authors: {[t[0] for t in texts]}")
        why = failure(lambda: licence_texts(scratch / "bare", "bare", "Foo-1.0", []))
        row("L2", why is not None and "bare" in why and "Foo-1.0" in why,
            f"no canonical text fails naming the package and id: {why}")
        for path in ("nested/LICENSE", "nested/sub/COPYING"):
            put(scratch / path, f"{path}\n")
        why = failure(lambda: licence_texts(scratch / "nested", "nested", "MIT", []))
        row("L3", why is not None and "sub/COPYING" in why,
            f"an unlisted nested licence fails, naming it: {why}")
        listed = scratch / "rquickjs-sys"
        for path in ("quickjs/LICENSE", "vendor/wasi-libc/NOTICE.md", "crate/Cargo.toml",
                     "crate/LICENSE"):
            put(listed / path, f"{path}\n")
        labels = [label for label, _ in licence_texts(listed, "rquickjs-sys", "MIT", [])]
        row("L4", "quickjs/LICENSE" in labels and "vendor/wasi-libc/NOTICE.md" not in labels
            and "crate/LICENSE" not in labels,
            f"a listed include is written, an exclude is not: {labels}")
        head = struct.pack(">IIiI", 0x00010000, 0x00018000, 0, 0x5F0F3CF5)
        sfnt = struct.pack(">IHHHH4sIII", 0x00010000, 1, 16, 0, 0, b"head", 0, 28, len(head))
        (scratch / "font.ttf").write_bytes(sfnt + head)
        got = font_revision(scratch / "font.ttf")
        row("F1", got == "1.500", f"the font revision is read from a synthetic sfnt: {got}")
        other = "0.0.1" if BUN_LICENSE_VERSION != "0.0.1" else "0.0.2"
        why, note = failure(lambda: bun_check(other, True)), bun_check(other, False)
        row("B1", why is not None and other in why and note is not None
            and BUN_LICENSE_VERSION in note and bun_check(BUN_LICENSE_VERSION, True) is None,
            f"a Bun mismatch fails under --strict-bun ({why}) and is noted without it")
    finally:
        shutil.rmtree(scratch, ignore_errors=True)

    failed = {name for name, ok in results if not ok}
    print(f"{len(results) - len(failed)}/{len(results)} rows pass")
    ok = failed == EXPECTED[mutant] if mutant else not failed
    print(f"MUTANT {'PASS' if ok else 'FAIL'}: {mutant} failed {sorted(failed)}, expected "
          f"{sorted(EXPECTED[mutant])}" if mutant else "PASS" if ok else "FAIL")
    return 0 if ok else 1


def main(argv=None) -> int:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="the acknowledgements (#376, spec §11 PUB-10)")
    parser.add_argument("--out", help="where to write Acknowledgements.txt")
    parser.add_argument("--strict-bun", action="store_true",
                        help="fail when bun --version is not BUN_LICENSE_VERSION (Distribution)")
    parser.add_argument("--sparkle-license", help="Sparkle's LICENSE, else found from $BUILD_DIR")
    parser.add_argument("--print-bun-version", action="store_true", help="for setup-bun")
    parser.add_argument("--selftest", action="store_true", help="D0 T1 G1 G2 N1 L1–L4 F1 B1")
    parser.add_argument("--mutant", choices=sorted(EXPECTED))
    args = parser.parse_args(argv)
    if args.selftest or args.mutant:
        return selftest(args.mutant)
    if args.print_bun_version:
        return print(BUN_LICENSE_VERSION) or 0
    if not args.out:
        parser.error("--out is required")
    try:
        sparkle = Path(args.sparkle_license) if args.sparkle_license else None
        entries = collect(ROOT, os.environ.get("BUILD_DIR"), args.strict_bun, sparkle)
        out = Path(args.out)  # atomically: a temporary file beside it, then os.replace
        out.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        handle, temporary = tempfile.mkstemp(prefix=".acknowledgements-", dir=str(out.parent))
        with os.fdopen(handle, "w", encoding="utf-8") as stream:
            stream.write(render(entries))
        os.chmod(temporary, 0o644)
        os.replace(temporary, out)
    except (Failed, OSError, ValueError, KeyError, subprocess.SubprocessError) as error:
        print(f"error: {error}", file=sys.stderr, flush=True)
        return 1
    print(f"acknowledgements: {len(entries)} entries in {args.out}", flush=True)
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())

1	#!/usr/bin/env python3
2	"""The acknowledgements (#376, spec §11 PUB-10): every third-party notice the bundle owes,
3	written each build into `Contents/Resources/Acknowledgements.txt` by project.yml's "Write
4	Acknowledgements" step; byte-identical for identical inputs, written atomically.
5	
6	    python3 tools/licenses/acknowledgements.py --out PATH [--strict-bun] [--sparkle-license PATH]
7	    python3 tools/licenses/acknowledgements.py --print-bun-version
8	    python3 tools/licenses/acknowledgements.py --selftest | --mutant dev-edges|nested-unchecked|bun-unchecked
9	
10	Crates over every non-dev edge of `cargo metadata` (not FIRST_PARTY), npm from `agent/bun.lock`
11	(no dev dependency or optional peer), each with its root licence files, else `spdx/<id>.txt`
12	under its authors, NESTED deciding every nested licence file; then Bun (BUN_LICENSE_VERSION,
13	`--strict-bun` refusing another), Sparkle, the encoders, the model and the fonts. D42/D43
14	(dist_check.py) read the file with their own readers. A `--mutant` fails exactly its rows:
15	`dev-edges` G1, `nested-unchecked` L3, `bun-unchecked` B1. Stdlib only, Python 3.9.
16	"""
17	
18	import argparse, json, os, re, shutil, struct, subprocess, sys, tempfile  # noqa: E401
19	from pathlib import Path
20	from typing import NamedTuple, Optional
21	
22	ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
23	HERE = ROOT / "tools" / "licenses"
24	sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT / "tools" / "codecs"))
25	import build_codecs  # noqa: E402  (PINS: the encoders, in order)
26	
27	FIRST_PARTY = ("framejob-core", "graphic", "framejob-mcp")
28	CARGO_ROOTS = ("core", "mcp-proxy")
29	TARGET = "aarch64-apple-darwin"
30	BUN_LICENSE_VERSION = "1.3.6"
31	LICENCE_PREFIXES = ("LICENSE", "LICENCE", "COPYING", "NOTICE", "UNLICENSE")
32	NESTED = {("rquickjs-sys", "quickjs/LICENSE"): True, ("rquickjs-sys", "vendor/wasi-libc/NOTICE.md"):
33	          False, ("fontdb", "tests/fonts/LICENSE.txt"): False,
34	          ("@anthropic-ai/sdk", "src/internal/qs/LICENSE.md"): True}
35	PATCHED = {"tiny-skia": "spec §11 PR-13"}
36	LIBRARY_LICENCES = {"svt-av1": "BSD-3-Clause-Clear (parts BSD-2-Clause), with the Alliance for "
37	                               "Open Media Patent License 1.0",
38	                    "libvpx": "BSD-3-Clause, with the WebM Project's patent grant"}
39	SPARKLE_LICENSE = Path("SourcePackages/artifacts/sparkle/Sparkle/LICENSE")
40	CRATES_IO = "registry+https://github.com/rust-lang/crates.io-index"
41	EXPECTED = {"dev-edges": {"G1"}, "nested-unchecked": {"L3"}, "bun-unchecked": {"B1"}}
42	MUTANT = None
43	PREAMBLE = ("Frame Job is licensed under the Apache License, Version 2.0. It includes the "
44	            "third-party software below, each under the licence its entry names, followed by "
45	            "that licence's full text (or, where the same text appeared above, a pointer to it).")
46	
47	
48	class Entry(NamedTuple):
49	    kind: str
50	    name: str
51	    version: str
52	    licence: str
53	    source: str
54	    texts: tuple  # ((label, text), ...)
55	
56	
57	class Failed(RuntimeError):
58	    pass
59	
60	
61	def read(path):
62	    return Path(path).read_text(encoding="utf-8", errors="replace")
63	
64	
65	def cargo_packages(metadata: dict) -> list:
66	    """Package dicts reachable from resolve.root over non-dev edges, FIRST_PARTY removed."""
67	    packages = {p["id"]: p for p in metadata["packages"]}
68	    nodes = {n["id"]: n for n in metadata["resolve"]["nodes"]}
69	    seen, stack = set(), [metadata["resolve"]["root"]]
70	    while stack:
71	        current = stack.pop()
72	        if current not in seen:
73	            seen.add(current)
74	            stack += [d["pkg"] for d in nodes[current].get("deps", []) if MUTANT == "dev-edges"
75	                      or any(k.get("kind") != "dev" for k in d.get("dep_kinds", []))]
76	    return [packages[i] for i in sorted(seen) if packages[i]["name"] not in FIRST_PARTY]
77	
78	
79	def npm_packages(lock_text: str) -> list:
80	    """[(name, version)] from workspaces[""].dependencies through each package's
81	    "dependencies"; not devDependencies, not optionalPeers."""
82	    lock = json.loads(re.sub(r",(\s*[}\]])", r"\1", lock_text))
83	    entries, found = lock.get("packages", {}), {}
84	    stack = [("", name) for name in sorted(lock["workspaces"][""].get("dependencies", {}))]
85	    while stack:
86	        parent, name = stack.pop()
87	        key = f"{parent}/{name}" if parent and f"{parent}/{name}" in entries else name
88	        if key not in entries:
89	            raise Failed(f"acknowledgements: {name} is not in agent/bun.lock's packages")
90	        if key in found:
91	            continue
92	        entry = entries[key]
93	        found[key] = (name, entry[0].rsplit("@", 1)[1])
94	        meta = entry[2] if len(entry) > 2 and isinstance(entry[2], dict) else {}
95	        stack += [(key, dep) for dep in sorted(meta.get("dependencies", {}))]
96	    return sorted(set(found.values()))
97	
98	
99	def licence_texts(directory: Path, owner: str, licence: str, authors: list) -> tuple:
100	    """((label, text), ...): the root licence files, else the canonical SPDX texts under the
101	    authors; then each nested licence file NESTED includes."""
102	    directory = Path(directory)
103	    texts = [(p.name, read(p)) for p in sorted(directory.iterdir())
104	             if p.is_file() and p.name.upper().startswith(LICENCE_PREFIXES)]
105	    if not texts:
106	        if not licence:
107	            raise Failed(f"acknowledgements: {owner} ships no licence file and declares none")
108	        holders = ", ".join(authors) if authors else f"the {owner} authors"
109	        ids = [t for t in re.findall(r"[A-Za-z0-9.+-]+", licence) if t not in ("AND", "OR", "WITH")]
110	        if " AND " not in licence and "(" not in licence:  # alternatives: the first with a text
111	            ids = [i for i in ids if (HERE / "spdx" / f"{i}.txt").is_file()][:1] or ids
112	        for spdx in ids:
113	            canonical = HERE / "spdx" / f"{spdx}.txt"
114	            if not canonical.is_file():
115	                raise Failed(f"acknowledgements: {owner} ships no licence file and there is no "
116	                             f"canonical text for {spdx} (tools/licenses/spdx/{spdx}.txt)")

def shipped_npm():

    try:

        return None, f"{BUN_LOCK}: {error}"

    package, each pin, Sparkle at project.yml's version, Bun, the model and each font."""
    path = os.path.join(app, ACKNOWLEDGEMENTS)
    try:
        with open(path, encoding="utf-8") as handle:
            headers = ACK_HEADER.findall(handle.read())
    except (OSError, UnicodeDecodeError) as error:
        return False, f"{path}: {error}"
    crates, reason = shipped_crates()
    if crates is None:
        return False, reason
    npm, reason = shipped_npm()
    if npm is None:
        return False, reason
    sparkle, reason = sparkle_version()
    if sparkle is None:
        return False, reason
    held = set(headers)
    named = {(kind, name) for kind, name, _ in headers}
    exact = ({("crate",) + c for c in crates} | {("npm",) + n for n in npm}
             | {("library", pin.name, pin.version) for pin in build_codecs.PINS}
             | {("framework", "sparkle", sparkle)})
    fonts = os.path.join(app, FONTS)

    anyversion = {("runtime", "bun"), ("model", "silero-vad")} | {("font", s) for s in stems}

    missing += sorted(" ".join(e) + " <any>" for e in anyversion - named)
    if missing:

"""The acknowledgements generator's selftest (#376, spec §11 PUB-10): no cargo, no network,
scratch only. Run through the generator, never alone:

    python3 tools/licenses/acknowledgements.py --selftest | --mutant dev-edges|nested-unchecked|bun-unchecked

Rows: D0 T1 the render; G1 G2 the crate walk; N1 N2 the npm walk; L1–L4 the licence texts;
F1 the font revision; B1 the Bun pin. A `--mutant` (acknowledgements.EXPECTED) must fail
exactly its rows.
"""

import shutil
import struct
import tempfile
from pathlib import Path

import acknowledgements as ack
from acknowledgements import Entry, Failed


def node(identifier, *deps):
    return {"id": identifier,
            "deps": [{"pkg": d, "dep_kinds": [{"kind": k}]} for d, k in deps]}


def failure(call):
    try:
        call()
    except Failed as error:
        return str(error)
    return None


def put(path, text):
    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    path.write_text(text)


def selftest(mutant=None):
    ack.MUTANT = mutant
    results = []

    def row(name, ok, detail):
        results.append((name, bool(ok)))
        print(f"  {'ok  ' if ok else 'FAIL'} {name} {detail}", flush=True)

    scratch = Path(tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix="acknowledgements-selftest-"))
    try:
        entries = [Entry("crate", "a", "1.0", "MIT", "crates.io", (("LICENSE", "text a\n"),)),
                   Entry("crate", "b", "2.0", "MIT", "crates.io", (("LICENSE", "text a\n"),)),
                   Entry("font", "F-Bold", "1.500", "OFL-1.1", "x", (("OFL-F.txt", "ofl\n"),))]
        one, two = ack.render(entries), ack.render(list(entries))
        row("D0", one.encode() == two.encode(),
            f"CONTROL: two renders are byte-identical ({len(one)} characters)")
        row("T1", "(identical to crate a 1.0's LICENSE, above)" in one
            and one.count("\ntext a\n") == 1, "a repeated text becomes the 'identical to' line")

        ids = ("framejob-core", "graphic", "lib", "devonly", "buildonly", "devdeep")
        metadata = {"packages": [{"id": i, "name": i, "version": "1"} for i in ids],
                    "resolve": {"root": "framejob-core", "nodes": [
                        node("framejob-core", ("graphic", None), ("devonly", "dev"),
                             ("buildonly", "build")),
                        node("graphic", ("lib", None)), node("lib"),
                        node("devonly", ("devdeep", None)), node("buildonly"), node("devdeep")]}}
        names = {p["name"] for p in ack.cargo_packages(metadata)}
        row("G1", not names & {"devonly", "devdeep", *ack.FIRST_PARTY} and "lib" in names,
            f"dev edges and first-party are excluded: {sorted(names)}")
        row("G2", "buildonly" in names, f"build edges are included: {sorted(names)}")

        lock = """{ "workspaces": { "": { "dependencies": { "a": "^1", }, "devDependencies": {
    "dev": "^1", }, }, }, "packages": { "a": ["a@1.2.0", "", { "dependencies": { "b": "^2", },
    "peerDependencies": { "p": "^1" }, "optionalPeers": ["p"], }, "sha512-x"], "b": ["b@2.0.1",
    "", {}, "y"], "dev": ["dev@1.0.0", "", {}, "z"], "p": ["p@1.0.0", "", {}, "w"], } }"""
        got = ack.npm_packages(lock)
        row("N1", got == [("a", "1.2.0", "node_modules/a"), ("b", "2.0.1", "node_modules/b")],
            f"a trailing-comma lock skips dev deps and optional peers: {got}")
        nested = """{ "workspaces": { "": { "dependencies": { "@s/a": "^1", "c": "^1" } } },
    "packages": { "@s/a": ["@s/a@1.0.0", "", { "dependencies": { "b": "^1" } }, "x"],
    "@s/a/b": ["b@1.0.0", "", { "dependencies": { "d": "^1", "e": "^1" } }, "x"],
    "@s/a/e": ["e@3.0.0", "", {}, "x"], "b": ["b@2.0.1", "", {}, "x"],
    "c": ["c@1.0.0", "", { "dependencies": { "b": "^2" } }, "x"],
    "d": ["d@1.0.0", "", {}, "x"], "e": ["e@1.0.0", "", {}, "x"] } }"""
        got = ack.npm_packages(nested)
        want = [("@s/a", "1.0.0", "node_modules/@s/a"),
                ("b", "1.0.0", "node_modules/@s/a/node_modules/b"),
                ("b", "2.0.1", "node_modules/b"), ("c", "1.0.0", "node_modules/c"),
                ("d", "1.0.0", "node_modules/d"),
                ("e", "3.0.0", "node_modules/@s/a/node_modules/e")]
        row("N2", got == want, f"nested keys resolve to the nearest chain and its folder: {got}")

        (scratch / "bare").mkdir()
        texts = ack.licence_texts(scratch / "bare", "bare", "MIT", ["Ann <ann@example.com>"])
        row("L1", len(texts) == 1 and texts[0][1].startswith("Copyright (c) Ann <ann@example")
            and "Permission is hereby granted" in texts[0][1],
            f"no licence file gives the SPDX text under the authors: {[t[0] for t in texts]}")
        why = failure(lambda: ack.licence_texts(scratch / "bare", "bare", "Foo-1.0", []))
        row("L2", why is not None and "bare" in why and "Foo-1.0" in why,
            f"no canonical text fails naming the package and id: {why}")
        for path in ("nested/LICENSE", "nested/sub/COPYING"):
            put(scratch / path, f"{path}\n")
        why = failure(lambda: ack.licence_texts(scratch / "nested", "nested", "MIT", []))
        row("L3", why is not None and "sub/COPYING" in why,
            f"an unlisted nested licence fails, naming it: {why}")
        listed = scratch / "rquickjs-sys"
        for path in ("quickjs/LICENSE", "vendor/wasi-libc/NOTICE.md", "crate/Cargo.toml",
                     "crate/LICENSE"):
            put(listed / path, f"{path}\n")
        labels = [label for label, _ in ack.licence_texts(listed, "rquickjs-sys", "MIT", [])]
        row("L4", "quickjs/LICENSE" in labels and "vendor/wasi-libc/NOTICE.md" not in labels
            and "crate/LICENSE" not in labels,
            f"a listed include is written, an exclude is not: {labels}")

        head = struct.pack(">IIiI", 0x00010000, 0x00018000, 0, 0x5F0F3CF5)
        sfnt = struct.pack(">IHHHH4sIII", 0x00010000, 1, 16, 0, 0, b"head", 0, 28, len(head))
        (scratch / "font.ttf").write_bytes(sfnt + head)
        got = ack.font_revision(scratch / "font.ttf")
        row("F1", got == "1.500", f"the font revision is read from a synthetic sfnt: {got}")

        pinned = ack.BUN_LICENSE_VERSION
        other = "0.0.1" if pinned != "0.0.1" else "0.0.2"
        why, note = failure(lambda: ack.bun_check(other, True)), ack.bun_check(other, False)
        row("B1", why is not None and other in why and note is not None
            and pinned in note and ack.bun_check(pinned, True) is None,
            f"a Bun mismatch fails under --strict-bun ({why}) and is noted without it")
    finally:
        shutil.rmtree(scratch, ignore_errors=True)

    failed = {name for name, ok in results if not ok}
    print(f"{len(results) - len(failed)}/{len(results)} rows pass")
    if mutant:
        ok = failed == ack.EXPECTED[mutant]
        print(f"MUTANT {'PASS' if ok else 'FAIL'}: {mutant} failed {sorted(failed)}, expected "
              f"{sorted(ack.EXPECTED[mutant])}")
    else:
        ok = not failed
        print("PASS" if ok else "FAIL")
    return 0 if ok else 1
